description: Zes uur zones drinkwater Rijkswaterstaat innamepunten is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De beschermingszones zijn bedoeld om te kunnen acteren op potentiele bedreigingen voor de waterkwaliteit ter plaatse van de waterwinning (het innamepunt). De beschermingszones zijn gebaseerd op een 6-uur contour, rekening houdend met stroming en wind en tevens dat binnen deze contour extra preventieve en curatieve maatregelen nodign kunnen zijn vanwege calamiteiten. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are 6-uur-zone, drinkwater, innamepunt-drinkwater. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
